Interface WhoErrorCode

All Known Implementing Classes:
AlreadyLinkedException, ApiKeyCannotManageKeysException, ApiKeyNotFoundException, BrowserSessionRequiredException, EmailAddressTakenException, EmailCredentialNotFoundException, HumanCheckFailedException, IdentityNotFoundException, IdentityOutranksCallerException, InsufficientUserAuthenticationException, InvalidAdminRequestException, InvalidApiKeyRequestException, InvalidEmailAddressConfirmationException, InvalidInvitationException, InvalidPasskeyRegistrationException, LastAdminException, LinkedAccountNotFoundException, NotSignedInException, PasskeyNotFoundException, PendingSignUpNotFoundException, PermissionRequiredException, ReauthenticationRequiredException, RecentSignInUnavailableException, RoleGrantForbiddenException, SelfDeactivationException, SessionNotFoundException, SignInFailedException, SignUpRefusedException, UnknownProviderException, UnknownRoleException
public interface WhoErrorCode
A failure who hands to the application, named by a stable code. WhoExceptionHandoff sends the code in the "Who-Error" response header, beside whatever body the application writes, so a client can tell failures apart without knowing the body's shape.

The codes are a public contract: kebab-case, and unchanged across releases.
